kind.description: `organizer` is Ísland, the root. `area` is a post code or a grouping circle, `location` a Staðsetning (a venue), `facilitator` the Lóðsar.

parentSlug.description: The circle this one hangs under; null for the root.

memberCount.description: Active members. Grouping circles (Póstnúmer, Staðsetningar) hold none of their own.

id.description: Stable id of the place entry; also opens it on talasaman.is/stadir?stadur=<id>.

place.description: The name the person gave the place.

answer.description: An answer word for word, identical answers (case and spacing folded) collapsed.
